caption:
Figure 3: Overview of our two-stage failure-aware adaptation framework. Starting from a
frozen backbone with adapted LoRA parameters, (a) Stage 1 trains Background-aware LoRA to
correct background leakage, and (b) Stage 2 freezes the preceding components and trains CIC to
correct the remaining directional errors.
delegated_acceptance_review: Actually viewed final two-stage framework and read caption and all independent checks. Both full source stages retain image/mask/depth stacks, LoRA and CIC insets, bottom feedback routes, classifier over/under paths and all training-state icons. New stage descriptions exactly follow caption: background-leakage correction followed by frozen preceding components and CIC directional-error training. Snowflake/flame key explains the existing encodings; no new loop or loss is added.
